newsitem.title: ZAMBIA: ZCCM Jan copper output up but below target.
newsitem.headline: ZCCM Jan copper output up but below target.

text.p: Zambia Consolidated Copper Mines (ZCCM) copper production increased in January over December but was still below target, a company spokesman said.
Copper production increased to 27,376 tonnes from 26,632 tonnes in December. The budgeted target for January was 33,213 tonnes.
"The deficit was mainly due to the continuing poor performance of the Nkana smelter," the spokesman said.
Cobalt production fell to 366 tonnes from 430 tonnes in December, against a target 444 tonnes.
"This is the second consecutive month that cobalt production has been below target," the spokesman said.
"The poor production of cobalt is mainly due to the continued low availability of high grade Nchanga cobalt concentrate," he added.
